sai: Heads-up — during the int8 bring-up for hf/model-x I hit a weird sampling regression. generation_config.json had rep/temperature as strings and our RW mapping seemed to ignore rep_penalty when the chat template included sentinel tokens.

lina: ugh. can you paste the genconfig?

sai: sure: 
```json
{
  \"temperature\": \"1.0\",
  \"top_p\": 0.92,
  \"top_k\": \"40\",
  \"repetition_penalty\": \"1.15\",
  \"do_sample\": true
}
```

sai: test harness call was: `pytest tests/hf_bridge/test_sampling.py::test_model_x_quant_sampling --seed 42`

alex: are we sure the issue is rep_penalty and not tokenizer special tokens? sentinel tokens in the chat template (e.g. <|bot|>) might be getting normalized/removed and that changes prefix tokens -> different sampling dynamics.

maria: I reproduced a minimal case: same model, exact prompt with sentinel token, CPU vs GPU quantized run differ in top-k trimming. Logs show rep_penalty not applied on a subset of steps (jump in entropy).

lina: can someone dump the runtime param map? I suspect our HF->Redwood coercion is doing string->int conversion for top_k but silently failing for repetition_penalty because we expect float and use `int()` in one path.

alex: snippet from the bridge: `params[\"top_k\"] = int(cfg.get(\"top_k\", default))` and later `rep = cfg.get(\"repetition_penalty\") or default; engine.set_rep_penalty(rep)` — no coercion on rep. If rep is string, engine.set_rep_penalty expects float; downstream C binding rejects silently and uses default 1.0.

sai: that matches what I saw. genconfig had strings (HF exporter sometimes writes numerics as strings?). When we load, top_k got coerced (by int()) but rep stayed string and got dropped.

infra-bot: CI status: test_model_x_quant_sampling failed on linux-int8 (see build 5482).

maria: also: when sentinel token is present in chat template, our prompt serialization adds an extra space before sentinel which shifts tokenization boundaries. Combined with rep_penalty missing, the model repeats certain n-grams.

lina: proposed fixes: 1) strict coercion helper for HF imports: coerce_number(value, type_hint) that accepts numeric strings; 2) validate generation_config.json on import and emit warning/errors for mismatched types; 3) add a regression test: roundtrip HF genconfig -> RW params -> engine call and assert identical numeric types.

alex: +1. Also add a small deterministic logprob diff test: run identical seed on fp16 vs int8 and assert no >0.3 nats drift for first 32 tokens after prompt when quantization only applied. This catches sampling/rep issues early.

maria: for immediate mitigation we should have fallback precedence: explicit per-request params > parsed generation_config (after coercion) > model.config defaults > RW hard defaults. Make that visible in Console for quick debugging.

sai: agree. I can monkeypatch a quick converter in the HF importer today: `coerce = lambda v: float(v) if isinstance(v, str) and re.match(r\"^\\d+\\.?\\d*$\", v) else v` — but I'll do a safer helper.

lina: assign: lina -> add coercion + validation in importer, add unit test harness. alex -> add engine-level check that rejects non-float rep_penalty with clear log. maria -> write quant sampling logprob regression test (int8 vs fp16). sai -> write reproduction case and sample logs.

alex: minor gotcha: we also need to ensure chat template sentinel tokens are present in tokenizer special tokens mapping. If HF model config uses `additional_special_tokens` we must merge them before serialization, otherwise token boundaries differ.

maria: noted — I saw `config.added_tokens_encoder` absent in the HF artifact we got. pipeline export bug?

sai: timeline? this is blocking a customer smoke test tomorrow.

lina: I'll aim for a patch + tests by EOD (today). If not, fallback plan: force rep_penalty=1.15 in request-level override for the smoke test.

alex: I'll open a tiny PR for the engine logging and create the Console UI hint ticket.

infra-bot: Ticket created: RW-issue-2178 \"HF genconfig numeric coercion + rep_penalty fallout\" assigned -> lina, alex, maria, sai. CI triggered for patch-branch.

sai: thanks. I'll paste the failing log snippet here if anyone needs it: 
```
2026-02-21T14:02:11Z engine:apply_params request=0x7f tmp_rep=\"1.15\" -> parse_error -> using default 1.0
2026-02-21T14:02:11Z sampler:entropy spike tokens=23..27 entropy=5.6->8.1
```
maria: thanks — helpful. I'll start the int8 vs fp16 sampling runs now and post diffs.

lina: moving to PR now. will ping when CI passes. :thumbsup:

sai: cool, thanks all.
